//: The fast per-PR checks that skip a pull request whose diff touches none of their inputs (scripts/ci/fast_check_route.py).
Each workflow below has a fast-check-route job (ubuntu-latest) and each listed job's if: reads its output; a skipped
job reports skipped, which a required check reads as passed. The feat-cmux-next push runs every one of them (or its
push_cover workflows do), so a miss is a fix-forward on base. `fast_check_route.py check` holds every input to a
tracked path and every path the job's steps and scripts read to an input.

fast-gates.why: web lint, crash ratchet, prepush gate, crash-class rules, the webviews checks and entry logs: each judges only what the change adds in these trees

not_inputs.scripts/install-git-hooks.sh: web_lint_prepush.py names it in its advice; the gate never runs it
not_inputs.scripts/web-lint.sh: web_lint_prepush.py FIX_COMMAND: the fix it prints, not run by the gate
not_inputs.tests/: web_lint_prepush.py SOURCE_DIRS: a web package's own tests/ folder, inside the package (an input)
not_inputs.design/surface-materials.md: prepush-gate.py names it in a check title; the check reads schemas/surface-materials/
not_inputs.docs/app-store-platonic-ideal.md: prepush-gate.py names it in a check title

ci-guard-group.why: the ci guard group and the groups a change routes (detect_linux_guard_changes.classify_feat): the guard tests read .github/, tests/ and scripts/; a product path runs it only when a group owns it

own-change-checks.why: the size cap, crash ratchet, spawn-owner ratchet and localization debt ratchet read their source trees; the generated files guard reads every added file's header and every generated output

not_inputs.plans/cmux-next/code-quality.md: check-app-size.sh names it in its message
not_inputs.scripts/: localization_catalog.py joins ROOT / "scripts" with its declared data files
not_inputs.backend/packages/protocol/: generated_outputs.py: a regex of a generator's inputs (generated: true covers its paths)
not_inputs.cmux-tui/bindings/go-pane/examples/hello: generated_merge.py REGENERATE: a command's --out, run by regenerate, never by the audit the job runs
not_inputs.cmux-tui/bindings/go-pane/internal/richp: generated_merge.py REGENERATE: a command's --out, not read by the audit
not_inputs.cmux-tui/bindings/go-pane/testdata/pane-: generated_merge.py REGENERATE: a command's --ir, not read by the audit
not_inputs.scripts/generate-claude-launch-environme: generated_merge.py REGENERATE: a command, not run by the audit
not_inputs.web/scripts/export-next-docs.ts: generated_merge.py REGENERATE: a command, not run by the audit
not_inputs.workers/cmux-vm/cli/scripts/regenerate.s: generated_merge.py REGENERATE: a command, not run by the audit
not_inputs.workers/iroh-v2/: generated_merge.py REGENERATE: a command's working directory, not read by the audit

react-doctor.why: React Doctor scans only the React projects a change touches (react_doctor_gate.PROJECTS) and rescans all for a gate input (GATE_INPUTS)

not_inputs.scripts/ci/: the step puts scripts/ci on sys.path to import react_doctor_gate (an input)
